messages:
Jordan: T-minus 45 to canary deploy. Quick sync — who’s on smoke and who’s on rollback?
Priya: I’ll take primary smoke (latency + errors). I’ll watch traces and the api-rate metrics.
Miguel: I’m on rollback path/exec if needed. I have the steps open in the runbook.
Sam: QA will run the post-deploy smoke script and basic regression suite. ETA for results ~10m after canary.
Aisha: I’ll coordinate customer comms if we need a rollback. Also collecting any feature flags to flip.
Jordan: Awesome. Miguel — can you confirm rollback command + expected downtime? Put exact commands so anyone can run.
Miguel: Rollback command (from deploy bastion):
```
/opt/deploy/bin/release_ctl rollback --release 2026-03-17-rc4 --env prod-canary --confirm
```
Expect by design rolling rollback across canary hosts, ~2-5m to finish, <1% 5xx spike while draining.
Priya: Criteria to trigger rollback (my suggested):
- sustained p50 latency > 2s for 3 consecutive minutes
- error rate (5xx) > 0.5% for 5m
- data-corruption alert or significant customer-facing failures
If any of these, call rollback.
Sam: Adding QA checks: data-save smoke, auth flows, embeddings endpoint sanity. If any of those fail we escalate.
Aisha: Who is the final go/no-go? Jordan?
Jordan: I’ll be go/no-go owner for the canary cutover. Please ping me ASAP with the checks. If everyone thumbs-up by T+15, we continue to full rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy window lock set by Jordan for 2026-03-17 17:00-18:00 UTC. Canary target: 10% traffic.
Priya: Quick confirmation: monitoring dashboard link -> https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/abcd123/canary-overview
Miguel: I updated the rollback runbook section with exact host names and ssh hints. Path: /runbooks/rollback/canary-2026-03-17.md
Sam: I’ll paste failing test snippets here if anything flakier shows up.
Jordan: One more: mute non-critical alerts for this window (SRE already applied suppressions). Priya, can you confirm alert suppressions are active?
Priya: Suppressions active for noise alerts (db-replica lag, background-job timeouts). Kept core error alerts on.
Aisha: Noted. If rollback happens, I’ll post a short note in #customers and ping account leads.
Miguel: If I trigger rollback I’ll post the `rollback started` message + before/after release IDs.
Jordan: Cool. Final checklist (reply with :thumbsup: when done)
- Priya: monitoring + primary smoke ✅
- Miguel: rollback ready + runbook updated ✅
- Sam: QA smoke script ready ✅
- Aisha: comms standby ✅
Jordan: If anyone sees anything odd after canary I’ll call it within 3m. Otherwise proceeding to increase to 50% at T+30.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Miguel: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Aisha: :thumbsup:
Jordan: Launching canary in 10.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release 2026-03-17-rc4 (10% traffic).
